body.label: Trigger
body.html: An enemy within 5 units declares an Action against an ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Create a glamour. The attacker suffers -1 die unless it changes to another eligible target.

surges.html: Choose a second ally within 2 units of the original ally; the attacker may change its target to either ally to avoid the penalty.
After this Reaction resolves, move one normal Condition between you and one willing ally within 3 units.
